parameter_descriptions.coordinate_frame: All poses and gravity vectors use the fixed GraspIt world frame.
parameter_descriptions.grasps: Snapshots in capture order; changing the scene after Capture does not change a saved snapshot.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].captured_at_utc: Capture time in UTC, ISO 8601 with milliseconds.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].dof_values: Raw hand degree-of-freedom values in robot DOF index order (zero based): radians for rotational DOFs, millimetres for linear DOFs. Coupled joints can share a DOF; these are separate from the actual joint angles below.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].gravity_direction_world: Dimensionless unit vector [gx, gy, gz] pointing in the direction gravity acts in world coordinates. Copied from the selected hand's current search gravity; select the optimum search result before Capture. Without a selected search result this may be the default world -Y direction.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].hand_name: Name of the selected hand in GraspIt at capture time.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].hand_pose_world: Rigid transform mapping the hand base frame into world coordinates.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].hand_pose_world.quaternion_xyzw: Hand base orientation as unit quaternion [x, y, z, w], mapping hand-local vectors into world coordinates.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].hand_pose_world.translation_mm: Hand base origin [x, y, z] in world coordinates, in millimetres.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints: Every joint in every kinematic chain, including coupled joints and fixed model offsets. Values are read directly from the current hand.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].angle_deg: The same actual revolute joint angle in degrees.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].angle_rad: Total DH theta rotation about this joint's local +Z axis in radians: joint_value_rad + model_offset_rad.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].chain_index: Zero-based index of the kinematic chain in the loaded hand model.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].chain_tip_link_name: Name of the last link in this chain, identifying the finger in the loaded hand model; omitted for chains with no links.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].displacement_mm: Total DH d translation along this joint's local +Z axis in millimetres: joint_value_mm + model_offset_mm. Present instead of angle fields for sliding joints.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].dof_index: Zero-based index into dof_values for the DOF driving this joint.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].joint_index: Zero-based joint index within that chain, not a link index.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].joint_value_mm: Current GraspIt prismatic joint coordinate in millimetres, excluding the fixed model offset.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].joint_value_rad: Current GraspIt revolute joint coordinate in radians, including DOF coupling but excluding the fixed model offset.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].model_offset_mm: Fixed DH translation offset in millimetres from the loaded hand model.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].model_offset_rad: Fixed Denavit-Hartenberg (DH) angular offset in radians from the loaded hand model.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].joints[].type: revolute means a rotational joint; prismatic means a sliding joint.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].object_name: Name of the grasp target, if one was selected at capture time; otherwise omitted.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].object_pose_world: Optional rigid transform mapping the target object's local frame into world coordinates at capture time.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].object_pose_world.quaternion_xy: Target object orientation as unit quaternion [x, y, z, w], mapping object-local vectors into world coordinates.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].object_pose_world.translation_m: Target object origin [x, y, z] in world coordinates, in millimetres.
parameter_descriptions.grasps[].screenshot: Relative path from this JSON file to the capture-time PNG of the main GraspIt window, including the displayed force arrows, gravity arrow and legend. Capture does not calculate missing forces or alter the camera.
parameter_descriptions.parameter_descriptions: Definitions of every saved parameter; dotted names refer to nested fields.
parameter_descriptions.schema_version: Version of this grasp snapshot file format.
